Fix Language Switcher Functionality
description: Epic to track all issues preventing the language switcher from working fully. The language switcher currently fails to restore user language preferences and provides inconsistent UI feedback.
design: Break down into specific technical fixes: session detection, UI initialization, translation coverage, and detection order.
acceptance_criteria: Language switcher works end-to-end: displays current language, persists across sessions, and translates all content.

title: Add Session Language Detection to i18next Middleware
description: The i18next detection configuration in lib/app.js currently only checks querystring, cookie, and header for language detection. It does not check req.session.language, which means authenticated users' language preferences are not restored on page loads after switching languages. This causes the language switcher to fall back to cookie/header detection, which may not be set or may be stale, resulting in inconsistent language display.
design: Modify the i18next detection order in lib/app.js to include a custom detector that checks req.session.language. Ensure the detector has higher priority than querystring but lower than explicit URL parameters if needed. Test with authenticated user sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated users see their selected language maintained across page loads and sessions. The i18next middleware prioritizes session-stored language over querystring/cookie.

title: Fix Language Switcher UI to Display Current Language
description: The language switcher in lib/components/nav.hbs always displays 'EN' regardless of the current language because it uses static '{{t "nav.lang_en"}}' text. The updateLangSwitcher() JavaScript function only runs after a manual language switch, not on initial page load, so there's no visual indication of the current language state. Users cannot tell which language is currently active without checking the page content.
design: Replace static '{{t "nav.lang_en"}}' with dynamic '{{upper lng}}' in nav.hbs. Add client-side initialization script that calls updateLangSwitcher() on DOMContentLoaded to set correct initial display. Ensure lng variable is available in template context. Consider adding CSS classes for better visual feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Language switcher button displays 'EN' when English is active and 'AR' when Arabic is active. Display updates correctly on page load and after switches. Works for both authenticated and unauthenticated users.

title: Complete Translation Coverage for All Templates
description: Many pages, especially landing pages in lib/pages/landing/*.hbs, contain hardcoded English text instead of translation keys. This means switching languages only affects navigation and authenticated pages, leaving landing pages in English. Examples include lib/pages/landing/hero.hbs with hardcoded strings like 'Build your startup' and 'Accelerate your journey'. This creates an inconsistent user experience where some content translates and some doesn't.
design: Audit all .hbs files in lib/pages/ and lib/components/ for hardcoded strings. Add missing translation keys to locales/en/translation.json and locales/ar/translation.json. Replace hardcoded text with appropriate {{t}} calls. Ensure Arabic translations are accurate and contextually appropriate. Test both languages after changes.
acceptance_criteria: All user-facing text in Handlebars templates uses {{t 'key'}} helpers instead of hardcoded strings. Landing pages, dashboard, and all other pages display correctly in both English and Arabic when language is switched. No hardcoded English text remains in templates.

title: Add Client-Side Language Initialization
description: There is no client-side code to initialize the correct language display on page load. The updateLangSwitcher() function is only called after manual language switches, not on initial page load. This means the page always shows 'EN' initially, even if the user has Arabic selected in their session or preferences. The initialization gap causes a poor user experience where the UI doesn't reflect the actual language state until after interaction.
design: Add a DOMContentLoaded event listener in nav.hbs that calls updateLangSwitcher() immediately on page load. Ensure the function can read the current language from i18next or a global variable set by the server. Test initialization timing to avoid race conditions with i18next loading.
acceptance_criteria: On page load, the language switcher immediately displays the correct current language ('EN' or 'AR') based on server-detected language. No delay or incorrect initial display. Works across all pages including landing and authenticated areas.

title: Fix i18next Detection Order and Add Database Fallback
description: The current i18next detection order prioritizes querystring parameters over more persistent methods, which can override user language preferences unexpectedly. Additionally, there's no fallback to check user profile language preferences stored in the database for authenticated users. This causes language switching to be unreliable and doesn't respect long-term user preferences stored in their profile.
design: Reorder i18next detection order in lib/app.js to prioritize session over querystring. Add a custom detector that checks the user profile language from database (via req.user.language) for authenticated requests. Update the /api/set-language endpoint to also update user profile if needed. Ensure backward compatibility with existing cookie-based detection.
acceptance_criteria: Language detection follows a logical hierarchy: explicit URL params > session > user profile > cookie > browser headers. Authenticated users' database-stored language preferences are used as fallback. Language switches persist correctly across sessions.
